name: No subcontractor tax-status checks

name: Cash / informal payments to staff / subs
description: Cash or Swish / Vipps used outside documented payroll.

name: No supplier tax / existence verification
description: Suppliers onboarded without check of VAT registration, premises, deliverables.

description: Invoices paid without documented receipt of goods / service.

name: No counterparty DD on high-VAT deals
description: Large VAT-reclaim transactions with counterparties not independently verified.

name: No tier-2 / tier-3 supply-chain checks
description: Indirect counterparties not verified for MTIC / carousel chain inclusion.

description: Staff untrained on CFA 2017 obligations and red flags.

name: No CFA-style facilitation risk assessment
description: No documented assessment of where facilitation risk lives in the business.
